_comment: Rule corpus for the system-imposed parallel window. Schema and semantics: README.md
in this directory. This is the SEED set -- three apps that ship on the device, chosen so
the engine can be exercised on a freshly wiped tablet that has no third-party apps at all.

_why: AOSP Contacts. The reference subject for this feature: a genuine list-detail app, on
the device already, and -- verified with `dumpsys package` -- one of the 131 of 178
packages that do NOT have androidx.window.extensions in their classloader. If the
engine works at all, it works here first.
packages.name: com.android.contacts

_why: LineageOS Gallery. Grid to viewer, which is the other common shape of this feature.
The picker and wallpaper flows are invoked BY other apps and must own the screen.
packages.name: org.lineageos.glimpse

_why: LineageOS Calendar. A month grid beside an event is the layout this feature is for,
and Etar is a useful third shape because its detail views are launched from a custom
view rather than a list row.
packages.name: org.lineageos.etar
